description: A row of menus that renders as a menubar on desktop and a single More actions sheet on mobile.
overview:
`ActionBar` groups several `ActionBarMenu`s, each with a `ActionBarTrigger` and `ActionBarContent`. On desktop it renders a `Menubar`: each menu is a `MenubarMenu`, and hovering another trigger while a menu is open switches menus.

Below the `48rem` breakpoint (`useIsMobile`), the bar collapses into a ghost icon `Button` that opens a `Drawer`. The drawer lists every menu's trigger as a row; choosing a row closes the drawer and opens that menu's items in an `AlertSheet`, with a Cancel button appended. Use it for toolbar-style command groups, such as File, Edit and View, that need to fit on small screens.
usage: Each child of `ActionBar` should be an `ActionBarMenu` containing one `ActionBarTrigger` and one `ActionBarContent`; the bar uses the child index to pair the mobile row with its sheet. `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange` on `ActionBar` control the mobile More actions drawer only; on desktop they have no effect. `ActionBarMenu` accepts its own `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange` for an individual menu, which apply on desktop and to the mobile sheet. Use `ActionBarShortcut` with `mod` to prefix the platform modifier key.

examples.WithIcons: Places an icon before each item in the Edit menu, including a destructive Delete item.
examples.OpenByDefault: Opens the File menu on first render using `defaultOpen` on the bar and the menu.
examples.NotDismissible: Sets `dismissible` to `false` so mobile sheets close only through an action or Cancel.
examples.CustomLabels: Renames the mobile More actions button and the sheet's Cancel button with `moreLabel` and `cancelLabel`.
examples.Floating: Detaches the mobile More actions drawer from the screen edges with `floating`.

parts.ActionBar: The root that renders a `Menubar` on desktop and a More actions button with a `Drawer` on mobile.
parts.ActionBarMenu: One menu in the bar; a `MenubarMenu` on desktop and an `AlertSheet` on mobile.
parts.ActionBarTrigger: The menu's button; a menubar trigger on desktop and a drawer row with a chevron on mobile.
parts.ActionBarContent: The menu's items; a `MenubarContent` popup on desktop and an `AlertSheetContent` with a Cancel button on mobile.
parts.ActionBarLabel: A non-interactive heading; a menu label on desktop and the sheet title on mobile.
parts.ActionBarItem: An actionable entry; a `MenubarItem` on desktop and an `AlertSheetAction` on mobile.
parts.ActionBarSeparator: A divider between item groups, rendered on desktop only.
parts.ActionBarShortcut: A keyboard shortcut hint aligned to the end of an item, rendered on desktop only.

ActionBar.open: Controls whether the mobile More actions drawer is open.
ActionBar.defaultOpen: Whether the mobile More actions drawer starts open when uncontrolled.
ActionBar.onOpenChange: Called when the mobile More actions drawer opens or closes.
ActionBar.dismissible: When `true`, mobile sheets close on an outside press; when `false`, they use an alert dialog that closes only through an action or Cancel.
ActionBar.floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with fully rounded corners.
ActionBar.moreLabel: Accessible label of the mobile More actions button and title of its drawer.
ActionBar.cancelLabel: Text of the Cancel button appended to each mobile sheet.

ActionBarMenu.onOpenChange: Called when this menu opens or closes.

ActionBarItem.variant: Use `destructive` to style the item as a destructive action.
ActionBarItem.disabled: Prevents the item from being chosen.

accessibility:
- On desktop the bar has the `menubar` role and each trigger and item has the `menuitem` role.
- Disabled items expose `aria-disabled="true"`.
- `Escape` closes an open menu and returns focus to its trigger.
- On mobile the More actions button is labelled by `moreLabel`, and each drawer row has `aria-haspopup="dialog"`.
notes: Parts carry `data-slot` values such as `action-bar`, `action-bar-menu`, `action-bar-trigger`, `action-bar-content`, `action-bar-item`, `action-bar-more`, `action-bar-label`, `action-bar-separator` and `action-bar-shortcut`. `ActionBarSeparator` and `ActionBarShortcut` render nothing on mobile.
